Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

tree — a tall plant with a trunk. Example: I plant a tree every year.
flower — the coloured part of a plant. Example: There are many flowers in the forest.
water — the clear liquid we drink. Example: We shouldn't waste water.
clean — not dirty. Example: Keep the park clean.
park — a public green place in a town. Example: There are two parks near my building.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• We should recycle.
• We shouldn't waste water.
• Keep the park clean.
• I plant a tree every year.
• It is good for nature.
